messages:
maya: Quick intake — prioritize onboarding LiteFlux-7B (chat) for quant experiments. Goal: get a smoke perf + quality baseline for int4 and int8. Scope: throughput/latency, batching profiles (batch sizes 1,2,4,8,16), ctx sweeps (128 / 512 / 2048). Compare quality to Zephyr-13B baseline on the standard eval suite. Can owners ack and call out blockers? target: smokebench by EOD Thu.

ravi: Ack, I can own perf onboarding. Will coordinate batching/ctx sweeps and run initial cold/warm latencies.

sam: Acknowledged. Need model artifacts (HF path + sha), tokenizer, and recommended sample prompts. Also any special config for kv-cache or rotary settings?

maya: HF path: https://huggingface.co/redwood/liteflux-7b-chat sha: a1b2c3d4. Pull command:

```
# pull model
git lfs pull && python -m hf_hub.download_repo --repo_id redwood/liteflux-7b-chat --revision a1b2c3d4
```

Use our standard convert script after download.

jen: Quant pipeline notes: need quant-tool v0.9.2+, docker image redwood/quant:2026-02. For int4 runs use fp16->int4 fallback profile and validate with calibration set of ~1k tokens. GPUs: prefer A100 for batch sweeps (perf), but we can smoke on V100/NVIDIA-80GB if A100 not available. Also collect KV cache memory traces.

sam: Eval sets I'll use: conversational_qa (100 prompts), code_synthesis_small (100), hallucination_checklist (100). Each eval: 5 seeds, sample 8, temp 0.2. Upload predictions to /evals/liteflux7b/run_<ts>.

perf-bot: Queue created: model=liteflux-7b, quant-presets=[int8,int4], tasks=[batch_sweep,ctx_sweep,warmup], batches=[1,2,4,8,16], ctx=[128,512,2048], owner=@ravi.

ravi: Quick plan snippet for runners:

```
# perf entrypoint (prod runner)
./run_perf --model /models/liteflux-7b --quant int4 --batch_sizes 1,2,4,8,16 --ctx 128,512,2048 --warmup_steps 20 --meas_steps 200 --out /tmp/liteflux_perf.json
```

I'll run cold starts and then warm steady-state. Collect p50/p95/p99 + token/sec.

jen: Quality regression: compare to zephyr-13b@v1.2. Thresholds: pass if delta RougeL > -1.5 and CodeBLEU > -2.0 and hallucination F1 not worse than -3%. Use eval-harness v2 to produce metrics and diff report. Script: `./eval_harness --ref zephyr13b@v1.2 --cand liteflux7b --suites conversational_qa,code_synthesis_small,hallucination_checklist --out reports/liteflux_regression.json`

sam: Potential blocker: tokenizer JSON mismatch on our token checks (found earlier with other tuf models). I'll run tokenization check against our canonical tokenizer.

maya: If int4 shows regressed quality we fallback to int8 for host and keep int4 as experimental. Also if kv-cache tweaks help, include them in the recommendations. Can someone run token-check + a quick int8 smoke now?

ravi: On it — starting token-check now, will kick int8 smoke after token verification.

perf-bot: token-check result: 1 mismatch (newline token id differs). Recommendation: apply local token mapping shim or re-run convert with `--preserve-newline-token`.

sam: Pushed quick mapping patch to bench-utils: `fix_token_map = {"\\n": 198}` — test pass locally for canonical prompts. Will open PR with unit test.

jen: Thanks — scheduling quant smokebench tonight on A100 pool (slot 3). Will attach raw logs + perf summary once complete.

maya: Great work team. I've set priority=high on the intake board and added note: business reason = PLG chat feature rollout. Please update this thread with smokebench link and any blockers. :rocket:

ravi: Will post results as soon as warm-run completes (est ~3.5h).

perf-bot: scheduled jobs: [liteflux7b_int8_smoke, liteflux7b_int4_smoke]. Logs will land in /logs/eng-ml/liteflux7b/<ts>.
